run_rendering_pipeline: run the rendering pipeline for all scenes by executing run_rendering.py with root=<path> and overwrite flags
prepare_scene_rendering: create a pyrender offscreen scene with a trimesh mesh and intrinsics camera for flat rendering
render_scene: render a pyrender scene to produce color and depth images from a given camera-to-world pose
prepare_mesh_rendering: prepare nvdiffrast rendering data from a trimesh or labeled mesh with camera intrinsics on GPU
render_mesh: render a mesh with nvdiffrast to produce color, depth, and face ID images from a camera pose
